items.text: What is the most embarrassing song you still know all the words to?
Do your best impression of a cartoon character until someone guesses which one.
What is your most irrational fear?
Talk in a funny accent of your choice until your next turn.
What is the worst gift you ever pretended to love?
Let the group give you a new name for the rest of the game.
What is a habit you hope nobody has noticed?
Do ten squats while counting out loud.
Which fictional character would you want as your best friend?
Balance a spoon on your nose for ten seconds.
What was the last thing you searched for on your phone?
Sing the chorus of the last song you played, with full dance moves.
What is the silliest thing you believed as a kid?
Talk like a pirate until your next turn.
If you could swap lives with anyone here for a day, who would it be?
Hold a plank for thirty seconds while the group counts down.
What is a food you pretend to like?
Do your best robot dance for twenty seconds.
Which movie have you claimed to have seen but never actually watched?
Speak only in questions until your next turn.
What is your go-to karaoke song?
Name ten things in a category the group picks, in fifteen seconds.
What is the weirdest item in your bag right now?
Hum a song and let the group guess the title.
What is a skill you wish you had learned as a child?
Give a thirty-second speech on why your favourite snack deserves a medal.
What is your most used emoji?
Balance on one foot for twenty seconds while reciting a nursery rhyme.
Who in this room would survive longest on a desert island?
Walk to the kitchen and back like a fashion model on a runway.
What is something you are still bad at, but do anyway?
Tell a joke with a straight face; if nobody laughs, do five jumping jacks.
What is the best compliment you have ever received?
Drink a full glass of water in one go without stopping.
If your phone battery had one hour left, what would you do first?
Describe the person on your right using only three words.
What is a rule you break every single time?
Commentate the last thing you did like a football announcer.
Which celebrity would you trust to babysit your pet?
Walk to the window in dramatic slow motion, then walk back.
What is the most useless talent you have?
Act out the music video of a song the group chooses, for thirty seconds.
What is your guilty pleasure TV show?
Thank the person next to you as if they just won an Oscar.
Have you ever cried at a film? Which one?
Recite the first lines of a famous poem with deeply fake emotion.
What would you buy first if you won the lottery?
Give a fake weather forecast for tomorrow in a serious news-anchor voice.
What is a word you always mispronounce?
Balance a cup on your head for ten seconds.
What is the strangest dream you remember?
Invent a magic trick and perform it with an imaginary wand.
Which friend here would be the worst at keeping a secret?
Do your best slow-motion sneeze.
What is the last lie you told, even a small one?
Make a silly sound every time someone says the word party until your next turn.
What is the most spontaneous thing you have ever done?
Do a victory dance for whoever has the most points, even if nobody is keeping score.
What do you still do when nobody is watching that you would be embarrassed to admit?
Teach the group a two-move dance and make everyone repeat it.
